subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain open as the umbrella for both structured reply metadata and no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split/close it once the reply PR and fallback contract issue are confirmed as the canonicals?
rationale: Current main is only partially addressed, and the remaining work defines cross-surface runtime/session and fallback-delivery contracts rather than a narrow code cleanup.
